subject: Penetration test deliverables and procurement attestation — Aurelia Health MAP
messages:
From: Samantha Liao <samantha.liao@aureliahealth.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: tom.hsu@aureliahealth.com
Date: 2026-08-10T09:12:00Z
Subject: Request: full pen test report + remediation status for procurement gating

Hi Neha,

We're moving the Aurelia Health cloud contract through procurement and security review this week. Procurement has requested the full penetration test report from your last engagement (scope and remediation status included) in order to clear the contract for our legal team. Our MQ/Audit gate is scheduled for 2026-08-17, so we need confirmation by EOB 2026-08-12 that we'll have deliverables suitable for redaction and review.

Specifically we need:
- Redacted pen test report (redactions acceptable for sensitive exploit PoC)
- A remediation tracker showing status, owner, and target dates for open findings
- A short attestation letter we can include in procurement materials stating that critical/high findings have been remediated or mitigated

Can you confirm availability and when we'll receive these? If there's an internal approval step for redaction, please loop in your security team.

Thanks,
Samantha Liao
Procurement Manager, Aurelia Health
Samantha.Liao@aureliahealth.com
+1 (617) 555-0147
From: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Liao <samantha.liao@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-10T12:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: full pen test report + remediation status for procurement gating

Hi Samantha — thanks for the heads-up and the deadline. We can provide a redacted report and a remediation tracker that lists severity, status, and dates.

Quick summary of next steps from our side:
- We will provide a redacted executive summary of the pen test by EOB 2026-08-11 and the remediation tracker by 2026-08-12.
- Full unredacted report is restricted; RedTeam's original findings include PII in PoC screenshots so we will only deliver a redacted PDF for procurement review.
- Our Security team (cc'd) will provide a short attestation letter confirming remediation state for high/critical items.

Attached: pen_test_summary_20260728-redacted.pdf (redacted executive summary), remediation_tracker_20260810.xlsx (working tracker).

Would you like a 30-min walkthrough call (security + procurement) on 2026-08-12 morning?

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
From: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-11T08:15:00Z
Subject: Fw: Request: full pen test report + remediation status for procurement gating

Internal: hooking you both in — procurement needs a redacted report + remediation tracker + attestation by next week to clear the MAP gate. See Sam's note below.

Questions for Security:
- Can we provide the redacted summary as-is? Any additional redactions required beyond PoCs?
- For the attestation letter: do we provide a statement of remediation completion dates for high/critical items and a scope note (what was tested)?
- Will we include evidence artifacts (patch versions, tickets) or just a summary and the tracker?

Marissa — procurement will want the attestation in a letterhead PDF. Can you advise on the legal wording they usually accept?

Thanks — Neha
From: soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-11T10:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Fw: Request: full pen test report + remediation status for procurement gating

On internal review: we ran the engagement with RedTeam LLC on 2026-07-28. The canonical full report contains PoC artifacts and internal hostnames that must be redacted.

Recommended deliverables for procurement:
- Redacted PDF (executive + technical findings) — acceptable for procurement review.
- Remediation tracker (we should include CVE references where applicable, brief description, status, owner, date remediated).
- Evidence bundle (screenshots of patches applied, pull request links, ticket IDs) can be provided as a separate ZIP to the security contact under an NDA.
- Attestation letter: we can sign a standard remediation attestation that lists high/critical findings and their remediation dates.

I attached an internal evidence bundle (security_evidence_bundle_20260811.zip) for our records — do not share the zip publicly; it is for internal review and to assemble the procurement evidence package.

I will review the redacted summary and confirm wording for the attestation.

— Soojin Lee
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com

Neha — received the redacted summary and tracker, thanks. Procurement will accept the redacted materials for the legal review contingent on a signed attestation confirming remediation of high/critical items.

One request: can the attestation explicitly state the remediation dates and indicate whether fixes were deployed to production or staged environments? Procurement needs that clarity.

If you can deliver the signed attestation by 2026-08-15 EOD, we should be able to clear the MAP gate without delay.

Thanks,
Samantha
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Liao <samantha.liao@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T16:45:00Z
Subject: Attestation: remediation status for RedTeam engagement (Aurelia Health MAP)

Samantha — attached is Redwood Inference's attestation letter and remediation evidence for the RedTeam engagement on 2026-07-28.

Summary:
- Engagement: RedTeam LLC penetration test (performed 2026-07-28).
- Scope: external perimeter and authentication flows for the Redwood-hosted inference control plane used by Aurelia Health (non-PII systems excluded).
- High/Critical findings: two items identified.
  1) Authentication token refresh race condition — remediated and deployed to production on 2026-08-05 (PR #4421; ticket INF-1287).
  2) Privilege escalation via privileged debug endpoint — mitigated and removed from production on 2026-08-07 (PR #4458; ticket INF-1312).
- Evidence: remediation_evidence_20260815.pdf includes screenshots of merged PRs, deployment timestamps, and ticket references.

Attached: attestation_letter_20260815.pdf, remediation_evidence_20260815.pdf

If procurement needs any additional format or a notarized letter, let me know and we can coordinate with Legal.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Trust & Security
Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
